title: Hoʻolauleʻa O Hāna (1970)
description: Community celebration in Hāna featuring hula hālau, traditional chant, and remarks from kūpuna. Filmed on August 16, 1970. Includes extended ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi segments without English translation.

roku.short_description: Community celebration in Hāna with hula hālau, oli, and kūpuna remarks. August 16, 1970.
roku.long_description: Community celebration in Hāna featuring hula hālau, traditional chant, and remarks from kūpuna. Filmed on August 16, 1970. Contains extended segments in ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi; auto-captions may be approximate where Hawaiian is spoken.
